# schema/value_forms — valid spec produces no diagnostics and exits 0
# No testserver needed; validate performs static analysis only.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

# Exercises Value forms that no other fixture covers: base64, list,
# now+offset, literal_int.

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    api_key:
      type: secret
      default: "test-bearer-token-12345"
    raw_marker:
      type: string
      default: "fingerprint:abc123"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.api_key}

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/events
    headers:
      X-Marker: {base64: {ref: state.raw_marker}}
    query:
      since:  {format: rfc3339, value: {now: true, offset: "-24h"}}
      scopes: {list: ["audit", "security", "ingest"]}
      limit:  100   # YAML scalar → Value.LiteralInt (no discriminator key form)

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  stateless: {}

error:
  mode: standard
